messages:
tyler_fin: Heads-up: Nimbus Therapeutics disputed INV-2027-0804-210. They say platform fee looks pro-rated twice and their support downgrade wasn't applied to the renewal. can billing confirm? :grimacing:

mike_billing: pulling files. contract NIM-2021-033, amendment AMD-2027-07 (support downgrade Standard->Basic effective 2027-07-12). invoice attached shows Support-Basic full month plus a separate proration charge.

anya_csm: customer initiated downgrade during their scheduled quarter close and asked that the effective date be 2027-07-12. Sales confirmed verbally. CS notes show request. they expected prorated refund for the 18 days of Standard in July, not an extra charge.

david_sales: we signed amendment but used a manual override in CRM that set effective_billing_date to 2027-08-01 by mistake. legal approved amendment but billing mapping didn't pick up the manual flag.

mike_billing: okay. invoice lines from PDF:

```
1 x Private Deployment License (annual)  $90,000.00
Platform Fee (annual)  $18,000.00
Support - Basic (monthly)  $1,050.00
Support - Proration Adjustment (Standard -> Basic)  $-1,950.00
Support - Standard (monthly, previous)  $1,950.00
Total  $110,050.00
Note: Downgrade effective 2027-08-01 per billing system
```

mike_billing: system shows amendment effective_date=2027-07-12 but billing_effective_date=2027-08-01 due to manual flag. The negative proration line and the old Support-Standard line together are confusing — looks like two adjustments were applied, resulting in no net proration credit and an extra charge.

eric_fpna: rough math: Standard $1,950 vs Basic $1,050 -> delta $900/mo. Prorate Standard->Basic for 18/31 days -> credit ~ $523. But the invoice shows a negative $1,950 and still charged Standard $1,950, so net overcharge appears to be $1,950 (the duplicate full Standard line). Need exact calc.

tyler_fin: also, vendor-payments-bot flagged a platform pass-through fee billed by our infra vendor for the migration window (line "Platform Vendor Surcharge") that duplicates part of our platform fee. customer says that vendor surcharge was to be absorbed by us per onboarding SOW.

vendor-payments-bot: Vendor charge VEND-2027-07-31 posted for NIM-2021-033  $2,400. SOW clause 5.2 indicates vendor onboarding surcharge to vendor, customer responsibility: No. (flag: billing mismatch).

david_sales: confirmed SOW states vendor onboarding surcharge is Redwood responsibility. that $2,400 should not have been passed to the customer.

sophie_finance: approvals: combined potential credit could be the duplicate Standard $1,950 plus vendor pass-through $2,400 minus any correct proration. Total estimated credit ~ $4,000+. Under $10k so finance auto-approve but require explanation and GL tagging. Eric, confirm recording path.

eric_fpna: agree auto-approve. We will post credits to reduce AR and adjust deferred revenue if needed. please include memo codes: "support-downgrade-nimbus" and "vendor-pass-through-correction". I'll handle journal entries once we have exact numbers.

mike_billing: I'll run precise ledger calc and produce two credit memos: CM-2027-0805-501 for Support duplicate/proration and CM-2027-0805-502 for Vendor Pass-Through $2,400. Drafts ETA 45m. Will attach amendment and SOW to both for audit trail.

anya_csm: customer is asking to see the credits in portal before their AR run on Friday. can we expedite?

mike_billing: will prioritize. tagging billing-engine to post both credits and update account notes.

billing-bot: Draft Credit Memo CM-2027-0805-501 created for NIM-2021-033  $1,950. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0805-501-draft.pdf

billing-bot: Draft Credit Memo CM-2027-0805-502 created for NIM-2021-033  $2,400. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0805-502-draft.pdf

mike_billing: posting both credits now. note on CM-501: "Credit for duplicate Support Standard charge due to billing_effective_date mismatch (amendment effective 2027-07-12)." note on CM-502: "Credit for Vendor onboarding surcharge incorrectly passed to customer; SOW clause 5.2 Redwood responsibility."

billing-bot: Credit Memo CM-2027-0805-501 posted and applied to INV-2027-0804-210  $1,950. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0805-501.pdf

billing-bot: Credit Memo CM-2027-0805-502 posted and applied to INV-2027-0804-210  $2,400. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0805-502.pdf

anya_csm: customer confirmed portal shows both credits and said "Thanks for the quick fix." will follow up to confirm the net balance.

eric_fpna: please tag month-end journal JNL-2027-08-REV-ADJ and include both memo codes. I'll coordinate the entries.

tyler_fin: couple of asks: 1) add a validation step for manual CRM billing flags before renewals 2) update migration/onboarding SOW checklist to ensure Vendor pass-throughs are validated in billing mapping. cc @david_sales.

david_sales: will add to sales ops playbook and ensure SOW clause flags get mapped to billing rule set.

sophie_finance: thanks team  good resolution. closing loop: keep this thread updated if customer reopens. otherwise merge attachments into the NIM account for audit.
